problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute the annual infrastructure budget across 15 different project categories to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The profile for each project category is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.126, environmental impact 0.154, allocation limits [0.007, 0.408]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.197, environmental impact 0.256, allocation limits [0.080, 0.311]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.088, environmental impact 0.238, allocation limits [0.048, 0.722]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.090, environmental impact 0.254, allocation limits [0.021, 0.818]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.123, environmental impact 0.165, allocation limits [0.080, 0.646]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.165, environmental impact 0.093, allocation limits [0.065, 0.428]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.038, environmental impact 0.024, allocation limits [0.030, 0.877]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.142, environmental impact 0.299, allocation limits [0.080, 0.745]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.080, environmental impact 0.127, allocation limits [0.043, 0.580]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.110, environmental impact 0.076, allocation limits [0.054, 0.862]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.158, environmental impact 0.225, allocation limits [0.020, 0.620]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.081, environmental impact 0.037, allocation limits [0.040, 0.669]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.131, environmental impact 0.255, allocation limits [0.062, 0.761]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.085, environmental impact 0.037, allocation limits [0.045, 0.560]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.098, environmental impact 0.108, allocation limits [0.076, 0.640]  

Each category must receive a budget share within its specified allocation limits, and the total budget shares must add to one. To ensure timely completion, the set of high-priority projects L = {D, G, J, K, M} must collectively receive at least 0.245 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the total environmental impact of the portfolio must not exceed 0.178, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.080.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
